title: Meridian Credit Policy Section 4.2 - Mandatory Documentation - All Applications
content:
## Section 4.2 - Mandatory Documentation - All Applications
Before an application can proceed to substantive credit assessment, all mandatory documents must be present and valid.

Mandatory baseline items include:
- completed application form
- identification documents
- supporting income documents
- privacy consent signed by the applicant
- purchase or security documents where relevant

If a mandatory item is missing, the file must be treated as incomplete. The application is not to be progressed to credit assessment, external verification ordering, or credit decisioning until the missing documentation is received.
